patch_description: The soft-min/soft-max annealing is limited by its temperature floor (T=0.04 still noticeably smooths the true ratio). I add (1) a deeper annealing stage (T=0.02, 0.01), and (2) a final L-BFGS-B polish directly on the exact objective f = (dmin/dmax)^2, using the correct analytic gradient via the argmin/argmax pair (chain rule through the two active distances). This gradient-following polish on the true (nonsmooth but piecewise) objective can squeeze the ratio past the soft surrogate's plateau, potentially exceeding the reference score of 1. Runtime stays small since it only runs once per start.
